quest.title: "That Guy"'s Scheme
quest.description: The fallen meteorites have turned Mondstadt upside down, inside and out. But it seems that the mysterious Vile is looking for people to help her out with a little something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fading Star's Might x20, Primogem x40, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Oh my, you're here at last. I've been waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Come on, don't be so cold. I have something very important to ask of you.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: I'm sure you've seen those meteorites. Though none of them landed inside the city of Mondstadt, the whole place is in an uproar all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: And where there's muddied water, there will be fish that don't belong trying to slip in unnoticed.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Aha, aren't you keen? That's an experienced adventurer for you.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Though the Knights are on high alert, there's bound to be some gaps in their defenses, what with having to send help to the areas around the city and all.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Those money-grubbing Treasure Hoarders have surely made plans to slip through those gaps and "make a killing," as they say.

choices.text: So, where do I fit in?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Oh my, what a straightforward answer.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: It seems like the contingency plan that gentleman gave me was unnecessary after all.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Well, simply put, that gentleman has apprehended the Treasure Hoarders who were scouting us out previously.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: According to them, there are three bands of these bandits looking to slip in during the chaos.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: So we'll play along, and help them create the ideal opening...

choices.text: And where do I come in?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: What you have to do is simple.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: To ensure that not everyone would be caught, the Treasure Hoarder scouts didn't report back directly. Instead, they would leave the intel they'd gathered in letters that would then be left in specially designated locations.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: To avoid any other problems from occurring, they also sent three scouts, who would then send the intelligence they gathered to three different locations.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: I doubt they expected that all three would be caught by that gentleman...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: The other Treasure Hoarders will only begin to plan their next move after receiving this intelligence, all the better to choose the best point of entry.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: But we'll spare them the trouble this time. That gentleman has already made most detailed plans for them.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Take these three letters with you, and place them at the locations designated by the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Once that's done, come back and report to me. As for what comes next... Let's discuss that later, shall we?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Haha, you're very cautious, aren't you? Don't worry, the Treasure Hoarders are quite the spineless lot.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: They are, in the end, just a bunch of small-timers who're in it for the money.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: "There's Mora in it for you if you work with us, but if you try anything funny..."

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: They were quite quick to cooperate once we reached this amicable understanding.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Haha, I thought you might say that.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Don't you worry about a thing, that gentleman has prepared quite the budget this time around. You stand to be well-compensated.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: And if you should pick anything up while going about this business, it's yours to keep.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: What's more, this task requires your unique touch.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Haha, of course not. How would they even blend in?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: I'm sure the knights would be all too ready for them if they even tried getting close to the walls.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: I'm talking about the Treasure Hoarders.

talks.objective: Place the letter at the meeting place
Place the letter at the meeting place
Place the letter at the meeting place

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: That will do. I trust that the Treasure Hunters will make their plans based on the intelligence contained within those letters.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: And that "ideal moment" should be somewhere between nightfall and dawn.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: As for the "ideal entry point..." Well, there can only be one, yes? Come, I'll mark it out on your map.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Well, that should do it. All we need to do now is wait for those Treasure Hoarders to walk into our trap.

choices.text: What if the Knights of Favonius find out?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Well, your concerns do have merit. Our unorthodox methods, if discovered by the Knights, could land us in hot water...

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: But rest assured, that gentleman has guaranteed that no such trouble will occur. So let's just... have a little faith, shall we?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: So, all you need to do is to wait till nightfall, and defeat our entrapped Treasure Hoarders.

choices.text: What if the Treasure Hoarders don't show up?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Oh, they will, alright. Don't you worry about that. These plans were laid by that gentleman himself. Nothing will go wrong.

talks.objective: Go to the designated place after nightfall (00:00 – 06:00) and defeat the Treasure Hoarders
Go to the designated place and defeat the Treasure Hoarders

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Have those Treasure Hoarders been taken care of?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Very well taken care of, indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Haha, I'd expect no less from someone who's caught that gentleman's eye. You're very efficient.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Here's your compensation. It was a... pleasure working with you.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: If fortune permits, we'll have a chance to do business again.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: You haven't set off yet? Ah, yes... You must have some other questions, then?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Hmm. That gentleman is an old acquaintance of yours, really. He says that you even fought side by side for a time.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: I can't give you his name, though. That would be on my head for sure.

choices.text: Why don't we just bring all those Treasure Hoarders in directly?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: You mean to say that even if we do defeat the three bands of Treasure Hoarders lured in by our messages, the rest will simply flee after hearing the news, yes?

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Well, that's true, but this is precisely the intention. That gentleman doesn't wish to catch them all, but to send them a little shock.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: Under the present circumstances, the Knights cannot spare the people to undertake a large manhunt.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: In any case, the falling meteorites are the top priority at present.

response.speaker: Vile
response.text: As for Treasure Hoarders, they just need to be... convinced to stop making trouble for now.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Taking care of this lot of brigands should encourage the rest to behave a little.
